learn.bodyEn: World Health Organization (WHO): A healthy person should have good physical health, mental health and social well-being.
learn.bodyZh: 聯合國世界衞生組織(WHO) 指出：要在生理、心理及社交三方面都達至良好狀況，才稱得上健康。
opts: Physical, mental and social well-being 生理、心理及社交良好
Only physical fitness 只有體能
Only absence of disease 只有沒有病
Only mental happiness 只有心理快樂
learn.a: Physical, mental and social well-being 生理、心理及社交良好
learn.why: WHO defines health holistically. WHO 從三方面定義健康。

learn.bodyEn: Do regular exercise, have a balanced diet, go to bed early, do not smoke, do not drink alcohol or take drugs.
learn.bodyZh: 要有適量運動、均衡膳食、早睡早起、避免吸煙飲酒或濫藥。
learn.qEn: Which habit supports a healthy lifestyle?
learn.qZh: 哪項習慣有助健康的生活模式？
opts: Regular exercise and balanced diet 適量運動及均衡膳食
Smoking to relieve stress 吸煙減壓
Skipping sleep for gaming 熬夜打機
Heavy alcohol use 大量飲酒
learn.a: Regular exercise and balanced diet 適量運動及均衡膳食
learn.why: Slides list positive habits. 簡報列出正面習慣。

learn.bodyEn: A balanced diet helps us grow, support daily activities, maintain body functions and control body mass.
learn.bodyZh: 均衡膳食有助我們生長、支持身體進行各項活動、維持身體功能及控制體重。
opts: Grow and maintain body functions 生長及維持身體功能
Avoid all physical activity 避免所有活動
Replace sleep entirely 完全取代睡眠
Eliminate the need for water 不需要喝水
learn.a: Grow and maintain body functions 生長及維持身體功能
learn.why: Four benefits from PPT Ch1. 課本第1章四項好處。

learn.bodyEn: Young people need 8–10 hours of sleep each day. Sleep helps us grow, repair body cells and resist diseases.
learn.bodyZh: 青少年每天需要有8至10小時的睡眠。睡眠有助我們生長、修補身體細胞及抵抗疾病。
learn.qEn: How much sleep do young people need daily?
learn.qZh: 青少年每天需要多少睡眠？
opts: 8–10 hours 8至10小時
2–3 hours 2至3小時
12–14 hours 12至14小時
No sleep needed 不需要睡眠
learn.a: 8–10 hours 8至10小時
learn.why: PPT recommendation for adolescents. 簡報對青少年的建議。

learn.bodyEn: Appropriate physical activities control body mass, strengthen body functions and help resist diseases.
learn.bodyZh: 適量的體能活動有助控制體重、增強身體各項功能及抵抗疾病。
opts: Control body mass and resist diseases 控制體重及抵抗疾病
Weaken heart function 削弱心臟功能
Increase smoking risk 增加吸煙風險
Reduce bone strength 減弱骨骼
learn.a: Control body mass and resist diseases 控制體重及抵抗疾病
learn.why: Three benefits from teaching slides. 教學簡報三項好處。

learn.qZh: 哪組屬於基本食物物質？

Vitamins, minerals, fibre only 只有維生素、礦物質、纖維

Starch and sugar only 只有澱粉和糖

learn.bodyEn: Carbohydrates are the main source of energy for our bodies.
learn.bodyZh: 碳水化合物是身體主要的能量來源。
opts: Energy for body activities 身體活動的能量
Cell membrane structure only 只有細胞膜結構

learn.why: Main energy source in slides. 簡報指出主要能量來源。

learn.bodyEn: The functions of lipids include energy storage, keeping warm, protecting organs, and forming cell membranes.
learn.bodyZh: 脂質在人體內的功能包括：能量儲備、保持體温、保護器官，以及合成細胞膜。

Produce digestive enzymes 製造消化酶
Carry oxygen in blood 在血液中運氧
Conduct nerve impulses 傳導神經衝動

learn.bodyEn: Proteins are a major component of muscles, bones, skin, hair and blood. They are especially important for growth and repair.
learn.bodyZh: 蛋白質是肌肉、骨骼、皮膚、毛髮和血液等組織的主要成分，對生長和修補組織非常重要。
opts: Growth and repair of body tissues 生長和修補身體組織
Storing starch only 只儲存澱粉
Filtering light in the eye 在眼中過濾光線
Producing carbon dioxide 製造二氧化碳

learn.why: Growth/repair role in PPT. 簡報中生長修補角色。

Carbohydrates and lipids only 只有碳水化合物和脂質
Proteins only 只有蛋白質
Starch and sugar only 只有澱粉和糖

learn.why: Protective group from PPT. 簡報保護性組別。

learn.bodyEn: Different dishes can provide the same food substances — e.g. rice, bread and noodles all supply carbohydrates.

Replace all proteins 取代所有蛋白質

learn.bodyEn: Food needs to be broken down into small, simple and soluble substances by a process called digestion, so body cells can absorb and use them.
learn.bodyZh: 食物須分解成細小、簡單且可溶的物質，這個過程稱為消化，以便身體細胞吸收和使用。
opts: Small, simple, soluble substances 細小、簡單、可溶的物質
Large complex molecules only 只有大型複合分子
Gases only 只有氣體
Undigested fibre only 只有未消化纖維
learn.a: Small, simple, soluble substances 細小、簡單、可溶的物質
learn.why: Core definition Ch3. 第3章核心定義。

learn.bodyEn: Digestion and absorption take place in the digestive system, made up of the alimentary canal and digestive glands.
learn.bodyZh: 食物的消化和吸收在消化系統內進行，由消化道和消化腺組成。
opts: Alimentary canal and digestive glands 消化道和消化腺
Lungs and trachea only 只有肺和氣管
Heart and blood vessels only 只有心臟和血管
Bones and muscles only 只有骨骼和肌肉
learn.a: Alimentary canal and digestive glands 消化道和消化腺
learn.why: System components from PPT. 簡報系統組成。

learn.bodyEn: Mechanical digestion breaks food into smaller pieces without forming new substances — e.g. chewing in the mouth.
learn.bodyZh: 機械消化把食物變成碎塊，過程中不會生成新的物質，例如在口腔咀嚼。
opts: Breaks food into pieces without new substances 把食物變成碎塊而不生成新物質
Uses enzymes to build proteins 用酶製造蛋白質
Absorbs nutrients in the stomach 在胃吸收營養
Filters blood in the liver 在肝過濾血液
learn.a: Breaks food into pieces without new substances 把食物變成碎塊而不生成新物質
learn.why: Mechanical vs chemical distinction. 機械與化學消化區別。

learn.bodyEn: Chemical digestion uses enzymes to break complex food substances into simpler ones — e.g. saliva enzymes break starch into sugar.
learn.bodyZh: 化學消化利用消化酶把複雜食物物質分解成簡單物質，例如唾液中的酶把澱粉分解成糖。
opts: Digestive enzymes 消化酶
Only teeth 只有牙齒
Sunlight 陽光
Magnetic fields 磁場
learn.a: Digestive enzymes 消化酶
learn.why: Enzymes essential for chemical digestion. 化學消化需要酶。

learn.bodyEn: In the mouth: teeth chew food (mechanical digestion) and saliva enzymes digest starch (chemical digestion).
learn.bodyZh: 在口腔內：牙齒咀嚼食物（機械消化），唾液中的酶分解澱粉（化學消化）。
learn.qEn: In the mouth, starch is broken down by…
opts: Saliva enzymes 唾液中的酶
Hydrochloric acid only 只有鹽酸
Bile only 只有膽汁
No digestion occurs 沒有消化
learn.a: Saliva enzymes 唾液中的酶
learn.why: Mouth processes from PPT. 簡報口腔過程。

learn.bodyEn: Most absorption of digested food occurs in the small intestine, where nutrients pass into the blood.
learn.bodyZh: 大部分已消化食物的吸收在小腸進行，營養素進入血液。
learn.qEn: Most nutrient absorption occurs in the…
learn.qZh: 大部分營養吸收在…進行
opts: Small intestine 小腸
Mouth 口腔
Oesophagus 食道
Large intestine only 只有大腸
learn.a: Small intestine 小腸
learn.why: Absorption site Ch3. 第3章吸收位置。
